segments.text: LEt a man this wiſe eſteme vs, euē as the miniſters of Chriſte, and ſtewardes of the ſecretes of God. Furthermore, it is required of the ſtewardes, that a man be found faithful: with me it is but a very ſmal thyng that I ſhoulde bee iudged of you, eyther of mannes iudgement: no I iudge not myne owne ſelfe, for I knowe nought by my ſelfe, yet am I not thereby iuſtified. It is the Lorde that iudgeth me. Therfore iudge nothing before the tyme, vntil the lorde come, whiche will lighten thinges that are hidde in darkenes, and open the counſayls of the heartes, and then ſhall euery man haue prayſe of god.
